mentions.name: WebPoke
mentions.description: WebPoke is a service offering a simpler alternative to implementing webhooks and data sync the traditional way. The author built a proof of concept using s2.dev and val.town and is exploring TLA+ models to see how the approach would hold up and falsify its claims.
mentions.problem: The author is tired of implementing webhooks and sync the same old way, finding the conventional approach cumbersome.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been getting tired of implementing webhooks and sync the same old way. https://webpoke.sudoscience.dev/ seems simpler. I did a poc using s2.dev and val.town [1] and am using the general idea to explore with TLA+ to see how it would model it to falsify the claims.
